text:
noah: Heads-up - the multi-model benchmark we ran as part of the qbringup shows a weird uplift in labeled variance for the promptset curation. Not an outright quality drop but labeler disagreement spikes on the rerank prompts.

 sana: which models/configs were in that sweep?

 noah: compared rdw-7b-int8 (control), rdw-7b-int4 (exp), and a new distilled_rdw-7b-int4-opt we pulled from the canary model catalog. Distilled variant shows +0.12 disagreement on rerank/gold pairs vs control.

 rita: interesting. is it concentrated on a prompt subtype? I can run a facet analysis.

 noah: yes - it's mostly: 1) multi-turn clarification prompts where the model truncates at different turn boundaries and 2) safety rephrasing prompts where distilled model prefers terse safe outputs.

 kevin: could be quant-induced beam preference shift or temperature change in decoding defaults. Did we standardize decoding params in the benchmark?

 noah: we forced decode params to match generation baseline (temp=.0, do_sample=false) but the distilled checkpoint has a different EOS handling; that changed where summarization stops, which cascades into different canonical responses used by labelers.

 label-ops: impact - annotators seeing slightly different reference outputs -> more borderline cases and more 'other' labels. This increased relabel cycles by ~20% and slowed throughput. We paused new rerank batches for the affected jobs.

 rita: plan suggestion: 1) freeze rerank labeling for this small cohort 2) collect 500 affected pairs and run a paired-labelling audit with two-pass adjudication 3) revert distilled variant from the rerank path until we confirm parity.

 sani: (typo) sana: +1 to audit. Also recommend we run a synthetic prompt perturbation test: take golden prompts, mutate whitespace/newlines/tokenization and re-run model outputs to measure EOS sensitivity. We should add an automated metric eos-shift to the onboarding checks.

 noah: I can extract the 500 pairs now. Script:
```
python tools/export_disagreement_pairs.py --bench run_6165 --filter rerank --min-disagree 0.3 --out /tmp/6165_pairs.json
```
Dry-run showed 512 pairs.

 kevin: also add a quick embed-delta check. If embedding similarity between control/exp outputs is > 0.95 but label disagreement differs, that suggests surface text differences causing label noise rather than semantic change.

 rita: good call. I'll run embed checks and add columns to the audit manifest: control_output, exp_output, control_embed, exp_embed, label_history.

 label-ops: audit process note - include original instruction_id and the label-snapshot commit hash. We don't want to accidentally overwrite golden labels during adjudication.

 audit-bot: ticket created: INF-5012 (rerank-adjudication-6165), INF-5013 (eos-shift-gate), INF-5014 (embed-delta-audit-tooling)

 noah: immediate mitigation: remove distilled_rdw from rerank routing (keep it enabled for free-form generation tests) and requeue the 512 pairs into an adjudication-only labeler queue. Will post manifest when queued.

 rita: I'll run the embed-delta job and generate the augmented manifest. Command I used locally:
```
python tools/augment_manifest_with_embeds.py --manifest /tmp/6165_pairs.json --model rdw-7b-int8 --model2 distilled_rdw-7b-int4 --out manifests/6165_aug.json
```
Expect ~3-4 min.

 sana: for the adjudication job, let's have three labelers per item with majority + one adjudicator for ties. label-ops can schedule.

 label-ops: scheduling note - we can stand up the adjudication job in 45m; please ensure manifest has instruction provenance and we tag these as 'adjudication-only'.

 kevin: long-term: add 'output-eos-consistency' and 'embed-sim-stability' checks to model onboarding pipeline. If distilled model fails eos-consistency > 0.05 on rerank prompts, fail gating. I'll add INF-5015 for onboarding gate.

 noah: follow-ups I will file: 1) revert rerank routing for distilled variant (done) 2) post manifest + queue id 3) run audit and attach adjudicator notes 4) update qbringup checklist with eos-shift and embed-delta checks.

 audit-bot: manifest uploaded: manifests/6165_aug.json, queued as job ADJ-7821, assigned labelers pending.

 rita: quick preview results: embed-delta median = 0.987 across pairs, but EOS-shift rate = 6.4% (control vs distilled). That aligns with label drop.

 sana: thanks. if EOS-shift correlates with new kernel paths or distilled tokenizer changes, we should add a 'normalize-eos' shim in curation that canonicalizes trailing punctuation/newline handling before pairing. But let's adjudicate first.

 noah: adjudication kickoff in 15m. will post final pass results here. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

 label-ops: note to reviewers - use adjudication rubric v2 and mark any label that relies purely on trailing punctuation as 'instruction-ambiguous'.

 noah: end-of-thread update: adjudication complete, ADJ-7821 results = 512 items -> consensus reached for 498, 14 flagged instruction-ambiguous. Decision: keep distilled_rdw out of rerank until tokenizer + eos normalization fixes. Closing loop and will open follow-up INFs for normalization patch.
